thesis: A service-led elevator franchise with rising ROIC still trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple and below peers, pricing a transitory margin squeeze and CEO transition as permanent impairment.
reason: Fair value was reached only on the conservative DCF leg; the multiple-discount thesis is intact, quality metrics are stable or improving and no trigger is near. Leverage drift, a guidance cut and a small bearish macro tilt cap conviction at 4, so no ADD; the existing position stays at its size into the Oct 28 results.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2021 5-year low of 15.2%, showing the service-margin squeeze is structural.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 5-year low of 10.0%, showing cash generation is deteriorating with margins.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.5x (3.04x TTM now), showing capital returns are being debt-funded.
Service operating margin in the earnings release falls below 20% for two consecutive quarters, or modernization backlog growth turns negative.

thesis: A net-cash, 40%-FCF-margin franchise with five years of rising ROIC and operating margin trades at the floor of its own 5-year multiples and a 9.82% FCF yield, pricing a guided fiscal 2027 reset as permanent.
reason: Thesis intact: returns, margins and FCF all still rising, no trigger near, valuation still at the 5-year floor. Conviction stays 4, not 5, given AI/free-filing risk to TurboTax and a small bearish macro tilt. The position already sits around its volatility-scaled conviction-4 size, so HOLD rather than ADD.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 15%, back to the FY2022 level, showing the returns expansion has reversed.
TTM operating margin falls below 23%, under the FY2024 level of 23.7%, showing restructuring and AI spend are not turning into efficiency.
TTM FCF margin falls below 29%, back to the FY2024 level, meaning the FY2026 cash step-up was transitory.
TTM gross margin falls below 78%, under the FY2023 five-year low of 79.3%, signalling free/AI tax-filing competition is forcing price cuts.

thesis: China's leading down-jacket brand, with 81.2% ROIC, net cash and a 12.15% FCF yield, trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales, where the price implies a -13.0% revenue decline its margins and cash flow do not show.
reason: Quality is rising, the balance sheet is net cash, and even the mechanical bear fair value sits above the price. Single-category weather risk, falling gross margin and added China concentration keep conviction at 4, not 5; standard volatility-scaled core size. Consumer Discretionary stays under the sector cap and holdings well below 15.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the five-year low of 57.2%, signalling loss of brand pricing power.
TTM net margin falls below 10%, reversing the five-year rise to 14.6% and indicating the brand premium has eroded.
TTM ROIC falls below 40%, a reversion toward FY2022 levels that undercuts the moat thesis.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 five-year low of 12.2%, signalling inventory or working-capital stress from a demand down-cycle.
